name: Prismatic DINO+SigLIP 224px + Llama-2 7B
license_note: Prismatic weights from TRI-ML. The Llama-2 7B inside them is under the Llama 2 Community License.
notes: OpenVLA's base_vlm, from the training config: prism-dinosiglip-224px+7b. LLM is llama2-7b-pure (meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf), not Llama-2-Chat. Vision is fused DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (vit_large_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m) and SigLIP So400m/14 (vit_so400m_patch14_siglip_224) at 224px. The 384px and controlled Prismatic runs are different checkpoints. The checkpoint stores only the projector and Llama-2 (32064 rows, same as OpenVLA); the vision towers were frozen in Prismatic training and are loaded from timm, as PrismaticVLM.from_pretrained does.
convention: question used verbatim (it carries 'Choices: A. ...' and the answer instruction), greedy; VLMEvalKit can_infer exact matching, unparsed is wrong
warnings: Prismatic checkpoints omit the frozen vision backbone; loaded vit_large_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m, vit_so400m_patch14_siglip_224 from timm as Prismatic does
